subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should the non-authoritative shadow scan land as this intermediate stack step, or only together with the later performance and safety work?
rationale: Tests establish accounting semantics, but they cannot determine whether the extra changed-corpus discovery and parsing cost is acceptable in production before later stack slices land.

options.title: Land with later optimization
options.body: Merge the prerequisite first and land this behavior only with the later bounded performance and safety work plus exact-head runtime proof.

options.title: Accept intermediate overhead
options.body: Merge this PR after its prerequisite and explicitly accept the temporary refresh-cost increase while legacy totals remain authoritative.

options.title: Gate shadow execution
options.body: Make shadow comparison opt-in or sampled until runtime evidence supports enabling it by default.

recommendation.title: Land with later optimization
recommendation.body: Merge the prerequisite first and land this behavior only with the later bounded performance and safety work plus exact-head runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and likely merger, they are the best available owner for the production runtime-cost decision.
